frozen_before: V2 launch; V2 has not been run
supersedes: nothing scientific. V1's J formula, thresholds, and gates are imported unchanged from experiments/sds_genome.py and experiments/strategic_demand_searcher.py, not redefined.
authorized_condition: ONLY if Searcher V1 exhausts its 6 preregistered generations without a development-eligible candidate. V2 must not launch while V1 is still attempting to complete, and must not launch merely because V1 crashed -- a crash is an infrastructure failure, not a scientific outcome, and V1 is relaunched unmodified via scripts/watchdog_searcher_v1.py until it either completes or exhausts its restart budget.

what_stays_identical_to_V1.J_formula: min(delta_G, delta_B_anchor) - degeneracy_penalty, imported from sds_genome.py, not reimplemented
what_stays_identical_to_V1.development_eligible: imported unchanged: delta_G > 0.05 AND precommitment_uncertain AND J > 0
what_stays_identical_to_V1.legal_A_bases: OP6, OP8, OP9, OP10, OP11, OP12 -- canonical registry entries, never overwritten
what_stays_identical_to_V1.confirmation_block: 2500001, remains untouched by search of any version

1_reliability.atomic_writes: tmp file + os.replace for every persisted artifact; V1 used direct write_text with no atomicity guarantee
1_reliability.resume_path: resumes from V2's OWN prior archive (artifacts/strategic_demand/searcher_v2/archive.json), not hardcoded to the screen archive. This was the bug that made V1 restarts re-derive generation 0 -- deterministically harmless there, but wasteful, and the bug is fixed for V2 rather than carried forward.
1_reliability.per_candidate_checkpoint: written immediately after each candidate's stage completes, same discipline V1 already had inside consider(), preserved and made atomic

2_hierarchical_evaluation.promotion_rule: successive halving: at each stage, promote only the TOP CEIL(pop/3) candidates by J to the next stage size. Not a hand-picked 'looks promising' call.
2_hierarchical_evaluation.rationale: V1 itself showed dG moving +0.375 -> +0.125 and gap moving +81 -> -7.3 between 8 and 16 pairs. Shallow estimates are not trustworthy rankings here; this is measured, not assumed from the FAMOU paper.

3_UCB_parent_selection.formula: UCB_i = mean(J_i) + c * sqrt(2 * ln(N) / n_i)
3_UCB_parent_selection.purpose: protects an under-sampled lineage (n_i small) from premature elimination by an unlucky 8-pair draw, without abandoning pure exploitation of the current best
3_UCB_parent_selection.used_for: selecting mutation/recombination PARENTS each generation; does not change the J formula or which candidates are development-eligible

4_weakness_directed_mutation.rule: for the SELECTED parent, compute which of {delta_G, gap, degeneracy} is furthest below a fixed target (delta_G target 0.15, gap target 0, degeneracy target 0) and bias the mutation AXIS distribution toward the gene group associated with that dimension
4_weakness_directed_mutation.constraint: mutation still draws from the SAME legal gene ranges already frozen in sds_genome.py (INT_BOUNDS, FLOAT_BOUNDS, HOLD_STEPS, OVERLAY_BOOL). Weakness pressure changes WHERE mutation samples, never WHAT counts as success, and never widens a legal bound.
4_weakness_directed_mutation.not_done: no new gene axes, no opponent-behavior DSL, no illegal dispatch keys. This maps existing genes to existing weaknesses; it does not add new mutation machinery.

5_pareto_archive.purpose: retain candidates that are exceptional on one dimension even if their combined J is negative, so a later generation's recombination can draw on their genes
5_pareto_archive.dominance: candidate X dominates Y if X >= Y on all of {delta_G, gap, -degeneracy_penalty} and > on at least one
5_pareto_archive.kept_separately_from: the J-ranked leaderboard used for promotion and UCB; the Pareto set is a gene bank, not a ranking

seeding.island_C_active: seeded from the lowest-frac_0_0 existing candidates

6_islands.migration: every 2 generations, the best candidate from each island (by J) is copied into the other two islands' breeding pools
6_islands.isolation: otherwise islands mutate and select independently, so a single lucky/unlucky lineage cannot dominate the whole population

explicitly_deferred_not_built_now: full opponent-behavior DSL (opening/trigger/role/transition programs) -- large rewrite, higher risk, needs its own design pass before implementation

REACTIVE diagnostic probe (V_oracle - V_reactive) -- PI already specified this as non-gating during the current V3 protocol and a baseline only AFTER V3_STRATEGIC_DEMAND = VALIDATED. Building it now would be scope creep against the PI's own phasing.
co-evolving evaluator pool / FP-DO payoff matrix -- explicitly a post-discovery phase (Phase 11), not part of finding the first clean A

budget.generations: adaptive, not a fixed heroic number
budget.continue_while: best deep-stage (32-pair) J improves OR the Pareto archive gains a new non-dominated point
budget.stop_when: two consecutive generations with neither improvement, OR a development-eligible candidate is found and frozen, OR a wall-clock cap of 12 hours is reached
budget.not_adopted: FAMOU's own iteration counts (hundreds) -- different domain, different compute budget, different mutation process (LLM-driven vs parametric). Copying that number would be cargo-culting, not evidence-based budgeting.

prohibited: changing the J formula, degeneracy_penalty, or development_eligible thresholds
widening any legal gene bound to manufacture a passing candidate
spending block 2500001 from search results of any generation
training PPO, a selector, or a latent policy
building the REACTIVE diagnostic as a gate (descriptive-only, post-validation)
auto-freezing a candidate as THE V3 opponent without a human decision -- V2 proposes, confirmation on 2500001 disposes

on_completion.if_development_eligible_candidate_found: freeze the genome, write CANDIDATE_A_V2.json with full provenance (genome, parent lineage, all stage results, RNG seed trail), STOP, human decides whether to spend 2500001
on_completion.if_exhausted_without_one: write V2_EXHAUSTED.md summarizing the Pareto archive and what each island learned, STOP, human decides next design move
